name: Button
description: Pure-CSS button on <button> or <a>: 6 variants, 4 sizes, loading state, group.

builder.summary: Six styles, four sizes, loading state, groups

data-size.label: Size
data-size.help: Smaller, larger, or a square icon button

aria-busy.label: Loading
aria-busy.help: Type true to show a spinner and block clicks

useWhen: A form submission or in-page action needs a clear, consistently styled trigger
Actions must be ranked by importance with primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive or link styles
An action runs asynchronously and should show a loading state that blocks repeat clicks
Related actions should be joined into a single attached group

avoidWhen.when: The button toggles an on/off state that stays pressed
A destructive action needs a deliberate press-and-hold confirmation
A marketing call to action needs an attention-grabbing animated style

classes.name: mv-button-group
classes.description: Container that joins several buttons together (add role="group").

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Size; icon = square (36px), icon-sm = 32px for toolbars, icon-xs = 24px for compact tables. Name icon-only buttons with aria-label.

attributes.name: aria-busy
attributes.description: Shows a spinner and blocks clicks.

a11y: Use a real <button> (or <a href> for navigation). Icon buttons must have an aria-label.
